rust_summary: a mod's own screen over the options page, the pause menu or an open container (`native_mod_screen_open_over`, `native_mod_screen_under_rect`).
doc_summary: `native_mod_screen_open_over(mod_id, keep_drawing_previous)` opens a mod's own screen over the options page (Options > Mods), the pause menu or the inventory or a container, not only over the world: Escape or `native_mod_screen_close` gives the replaced screen back, a server closing the container closes it for good, and a single-player game stays paused under a pausing screen. With `keep_drawing_previous` the pause menu's title or the container's panel is still drawn under the mod screen with no pointer over it, and `native_mod_screen_under_rect()` gives its panel (`[left, top, width, height]` in GUI pixels) for the mod to place its overlays by. It takes no clicks or keys while the mod screen is up. Bundles need "hooks": @API:mod_screen_over@.
